text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
See? You don't have to be from a 
prestigious family to run great! And 
Dober, you're officially part of my family 
now! You're totally allowed to be in both 
the Mejiros and ours!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Next, we're entering the "Oka Sho"! Let's 
expand the Pearl Family even more!
